weeks.note: RE-ENTRY. Vertical jump comes back about 18 days after an ultra, which is Thursday, so the running is all easy and the first box jumps start low. Durability is the through-line of the whole block: long sessions over 90 min are what preserve running economy under fatigue, which is the 70.3 run leg in one sentence.

sessions.label: Swim session 1, 07:00 Sloterparkbad - 50 m pool, lanes 07:00-08:00, before work. Warm-up 100 m easy + 10 bobs (in through the mouth only, out through mouth and nose, hard puff just before you turn). Cool-down 100 m easy. Main set easy, about 40 s per 25 m, breathe every 2nd stroke; if the panic starts, stand, 3-4 slow breaths, carry on. Press lap at every stop and set the pool size. Drills (breathing): side kick 4 x 25, 6-1-6 2 x 25, catch-up 2 x 25. Main: 8 x 25 with 30 s rest, then 2 x 50 with 60 s rest.

Strength UPPER - push and pull as one session, 45 min. Rows, pull-ups, overhead press, rear delts. Heavy, 4-6 reps, not hypertrophy ranges. Free against the running and cycling load. Dead hangs 3 x max at the end - grip is a genuine weakness at 32-36 s.
Easy 6 km, talk test, with 4-6 x 20 s strides in the last km - relaxed, no faster than goal pace.

Swim session 2, 07:00 Sloterparkbad - 50 m pool, lanes 07:00-08:00, before work. Warm-up 100 m easy + 10 bobs (in through the mouth only, out through mouth and nose, hard puff just before you turn). Cool-down 100 m easy. Main set easy, about 40 s per 25 m, breathe every 2nd stroke; if the panic starts, stand, 3-4 slow breaths, carry on. Press lap at every stop and set the pool size. Drills (body position): glide + kick with arms out front, turning to breathe, 4 x 25; kickboard 4 x 25, face in. Main: 6 x 50 with 45 s rest.

BIKE RAMP TEST - Zwift on the D100 (ERG). Eat 2-3 h before, fan on, bottle. Warm-up 10 min easy + 5 x 1 min at 100-110 rpm with 1 min easy between. Then the test: stay seated at 85-95 rpm and ride until you can't hold the cadence. FTP = 75% of the best 1-min power. DONE: Zwift FTP Ramp Test (Lite), stopped at the 230 W step, FTP 164 W. It sets the bike zones from week 2.

Strength LOWER - HEAVY, 45 min. Back squat 4 x 4 at 80 kg (77.5 if 13 Nov's 75 x 5 was near max), safety pins on (75 x 5 on 13 Nov puts the 1RM near 88-90 kg: 4 x 4 at 80 kg on 20 Nov, then add 2.5 kg when the last set moves well). Hack squat if there's no rack or you're wrecked. Then Bulgarian split squat 3 x 5/leg heavy, single-leg calf raises 3 x 8 loaded, Nordic curls 2 x 4. COMPLEX PAIRING: after each heavy set, 5 box jumps or 20 m of bounds within 2 min - heavy resistance plus plyo beats either alone for running economy. Heavy loads at or above 90% 1RM give greater economy gains than lighter ones, and the effect needs 10-14 weeks, which is exactly this block. LOWER-LEG AND FOOT, 5 min: tibialis anterior raises 3 x 15-20, heel walks 2 x 20 m, eccentric dorsiflexion 3 x 10, short-foot holds 3 x 30 s per side.

Swim session 3 (optional), 10:15 Sloterparkbad - 25 m pool, lanes 10:15-12:15. Warm-up 100 m easy + 10 bobs (in through the mouth only, out through mouth and nose, hard puff just before you turn). Cool-down 100 m easy. Main set easy, about 40 s per 25 m, breathe every 2nd stroke; if the panic starts, stand, 3-4 slow breaths, carry on. Press lap at every stop and set the pool size. Drills (arms): catch-up 2 x 25, one-arm freestyle 4 x 25, fingertip drag 2 x 25. Main: 4 x 75 with 45 s rest, then try 1 x 100.
Easy run 5 km, HR under 158. Third run of the week - short and genuinely easy.

Swim session 4, 09:00 Sloterparkbad - 50 m pool, lanes 09:00-12:00, after the long run. Warm-up 100 m easy + 10 bobs (in through the mouth only, out through mouth and nose, hard puff just before you turn). Cool-down 100 m easy. Main set easy, about 40 s per 25 m, breathe every 2nd stroke; if the panic starts, stand, 3-4 slow breaths, carry on. Press lap at every stop and set the pool size. Drills (breathing): side kick 4 x 25, 6-1-6 4 x 25, catch-up 2 x 25. Main: 4 x 100 with 60 s rest.
Long easy run 10 km, HR under 158. Aerobic base is the lever - the fastest runners get there on Zone 1 volume.

weeks.note: 5 KM RETEST Tuesday - it sets every run pace for the block. Hard days are Tue, Thu, Sat and Sun; Mon and Wed carry no swim, bike or run.

Long ride 2 h 30 - zone 2 (56-75% FTP, about 92-123 W, HR under 145), 85-95 rpm. Outdoors if it's dry and above about 5 C, otherwise Zwift. Fuel from 20 min: 40-60 g carb per hour. Then run 15 min off the bike, easy.

weeks.note: DOWN WEEK. Volume down about 30%, no brick after the long ride. Frequency stays: three swims, never a swim gap over 5 days.

sessions.label: Strength UPPER, 45 min - rows, pull-ups, overhead press, rear delts, 4-6 reps, 2 sets instead of 3 - down week. Dead hangs 3 x max at the end. No running or riding today: Monday is the endurance rest day.

Swim 07:00 Sloterparkbad - 50 m pool, lanes 07:00-08:00, before work. CONTINUOUS 800 m. Warm-up 100 m + 10 bobs, 10 min drills (side kick, catch-up). Main: 800 m without stopping, easy. Breathe out through mouth and nose, in through the mouth, every 2nd stroke. Then 4 x 25 m fast with full rest. Cool-down 100 m. Can't hold it calmly? Swim it as 2-3 pieces with 30 s rest and repeat the target next week.

THRESHOLD 4 x 1 km - threshold effort (HR 175-181, comfortably hard, about your 1-hour race effort), 90 s jog between. Warm-up 15 min easy + 4 strides, cool-down 10 min. Paces come from the 5 km retest.

Strength LOWER - HEAVY, 50 min. Back squat 3 x 3 at last week's weight - fewer sets, same load (down week), safety pins on; hack squat if there's no rack. Within 2 min of each squat set: depth jumps 3 x 5 (step off the Les Mills step, straight onto the 20-inch box) + pogo hops 2 x 15. Then Bulgarian split squat 3 x 5/leg heavy, Nordic curls 2 x 4, single-leg calf raises 3 x 8 loaded, tibialis raises 3 x 15. Heavy 3-5 reps is what moves running and cycling economy; light sets do not.

BIKE QUALITY 50 min on Zwift - 3 x 8 min sweet spot (88-93% FTP, about 144-153 W at FTP 164), 4 min easy between. Warm-up 10 min with 3 x 1 min at 100-110 rpm, cool-down 5-10 min. Fan on, a bottle per hour.
Run 15 min OFF THE BIKE, straight after Thursday's ride. Shoes by the trainer, out the door within 5 min. The first minutes feel wrong; that is the adaptation. Easy, HR under 158.

SWIM LESSON 5 of 6 - 1-on-1, 45 min. Book any weekday slot (coaches teaching at Het Marnix: Aqua Hero, SwimEasy, Your Personal Swim Coach); it replaces this week's Friday swim. Ask the coach to film you above and below the water. Breathing first, then sinking legs, then the catch.
Swim 10:15 Sloterparkbad - 25 m pool, lanes 10:15-12:15, after the long run, 30-40 min, easy. 4 x 100 m at CSS + 5 s, then drills.
Long run 12 km easy, HR under 158, talk test. Then the Saturday swim.
Long ride 2 h 00 - zone 2 (56-75% FTP, about 92-123 W, HR under 145), 85-95 rpm. Outdoors if it's dry and above about 5 C, otherwise Zwift. Fuel from 20 min: 40-60 g carb per hour.

weeks.note: 5 KM RETEST Tuesday resets the run paces for the race block. Longest base ride Sunday, 2 h 45 + 15 min run: outdoors if it's dry, otherwise Zwift. The 90 km race bike is over half your race time, so this is the ride that matters most.

sessions.label: Strength UPPER, 45 min - rows, pull-ups, overhead press, rear delts, 4-6 reps, 3 sets. Dead hangs 3 x max at the end. No running or riding today: Monday is the endurance rest day.

Swim 07:00 Sloterparkbad - 50 m pool, lanes 07:00-08:00, before work. CONTINUOUS 1200 m. Warm-up 100 m + 10 bobs, 10 min drills (side kick, catch-up). Main: 1200 m without stopping, easy. Breathe out through mouth and nose, in through the mouth, every 2nd stroke. Then nothing - 1200 m is the session. Cool-down 100 m. Can't hold it calmly? Swim it as 2-3 pieces with 30 s rest and repeat the target next week.
5 KM RETEST - flat, out-and-back, auto-pause OFF. Same route and warm-up as 24 Nov. Resets the run paces for the race block.

Strength LOWER - HEAVY, 50 min. Back squat 4 x 3-5 at 85-90% 1RM, add 2.5 kg when the last set moves well, safety pins on; hack squat if there's no rack. Within 2 min of each squat set: depth jumps 3 x 5 (step off the Les Mills step, straight onto the 20-inch box) + pogo hops 2 x 15. Then Bulgarian split squat 3 x 5/leg heavy, Nordic curls 2 x 4, single-leg calf raises 3 x 8 loaded, tibialis raises 3 x 15. Heavy 3-5 reps is what moves running and cycling economy; light sets do not.
BIKE QUALITY 75 min on Zwift - 4 x 10 min threshold (95-100% FTP, about 156-164 W), 4 min easy between. Warm-up 10 min with 3 x 1 min at 100-110 rpm, cool-down 5-10 min. Fan on, a bottle per hour.
Run 20 min OFF THE BIKE, straight after Thursday's ride. Shoes by the trainer, out the door within 5 min. The first minutes feel wrong; that is the adaptation. Easy, HR under 158.

SWIM LESSON 6 of 6 - 1-on-1, 45 min. Book any weekday slot (coaches teaching at Het Marnix: Aqua Hero, SwimEasy, Your Personal Swim Coach); it replaces this week's Friday swim. Ask the coach to film you above and below the water. Breathing first, then sinking legs, then the catch.
Optional easy spin 45 min on Zwift - zone 2 (56-75% FTP, about 92-123 W, HR under 145), 85-95 rpm. Non-impact aerobic volume that spares the shins. Skip it if you are wrecked.

Swim 10:15 Sloterparkbad - 25 m pool, lanes 10:15-12:15, after the long run, 30-40 min, easy. 3 x 200 m at CSS + 5 s, 30 s rest. COLD: finish with a 2-3 min cold shower. Five or six exposures cut the cold-shock gasp for months, and Jesolo is 15-17 C.
Long run 16 km STRUCTURED: 5 km easy, then 3 x (2 km steady at HR 165-172 + 1 km easy), 2 km easy to finish. Then the Saturday swim.

Long ride 2 h 45 - zone 2 (56-75% FTP, about 92-123 W, HR under 145), 85-95 rpm. Outdoors if it's dry and above about 5 C, otherwise Zwift. Fuel from 20 min: 40-60 g carb per hour. Then run 15 min off the bike, easy.

weeks.note: LAST FED WEEK BEFORE RAMADAN. ADMIN: (1) book the certificato medico agonistico - Italy requires an ECG-based sports medical on the FITRI form, and without it you are not issued a race pack. (2) Thursday is a RAMP TEST retest: the result rescales every watt for the race block. (3) RAMADAN starts about Mon 8 Feb, and weeks 15-18 are in Abu Dhabi (22 Feb - 20 Mar). Four short swims this week - frequency beats volume for motor learning. CUT ORDER if life gets busy: (1) the Friday ride, (2) the fourth swim, (3) Monday upper. Never cut the long ride, the long run, or below three swims.

Then Bulgarian split squat 3 x 5/leg heavy, Nordic curls 2 x 4, single-leg calf raises 3 x 8 loaded, tibialis raises 3 x 15. Heavy 3-5 reps is what moves running and cycling economy; light sets do not.

BIKE RAMP TEST (retest) - Zwift FTP Ramp Test (Lite) on the D100, ERG, the same variant as 18 Nov. Eat 2-3 h before, fan on, seated, about 22 pedal turns per 15 s (the D100's cadence reading is stuck around 66), ride until you can't turn the pedals. 18 Nov: stopped at the 230 W step, FTP 164 W. FTP = 75% of the best 1-min power. Send me the number: it rescales the race block.
Easy run 15 min after the ramp test, HR under 158.

Long run 14 km easy, HR under 158, talk test. Last 3 km at steady effort (HR 165-172). Then the Saturday swim.
Long ride 65 km steady. Last fed long ride before Ramadan - eat and drink normally, 40-60 g carb per hour.

weeks.note: RAMADAN STARTS about Mon 8 Feb (the moon sighting can move it a day). Weeks 13-17 follow the fast: hard and long sessions after iftar (light iftar, start 60-90 min later), short easy swims only in the last 1-2 hours before iftar, nothing hard and nothing over 60 min while fasted. Monday is a full rest day and the Friday zone-2 ride goes. HR runs higher at the same pace when you are dry - run by effort. First brick on Saturday: start the run within 5 minutes of racking the bike; the first 10 min feel wrong and it normalises by km 3. Get the bike fit done before Abu Dhabi: saddle height and cleat alignment are named ITBS contributors.

sessions.label: Swim at Het Marnix, 35 min before iftar - 1200 m continuous, easy. Tuesday lanes close 16:30, so 15:45-16:30; iftar is about 17:45. Fasted: no sprints.
4 x 1 km at 10K effort after iftar, 2 min jog. Ramadan: one rep fewer than planned, same pace.
Swim 40 min - drills, at Het Marnix in the 21:00-22:00 lane after iftar. Fed and watered, so make it the week's best-quality swim.

Legs - maintenance + glute-med, 30 min after iftar, before the 21:00 swim. LOWER-LEG AND FOOT, about 5 min at the end: tibialis anterior raises 3 x 15-20 (heels on a step, toes lifting), heel walks 2 x 20 m, eccentric dorsiflexion 3 x 10 slow against a band, short-foot holds 3 x 30 s per side, tennis ball under the arch 60 s. An 8-week RCT in amateur runners raised lactate threshold velocity 5.9% with intrinsic foot work - but that was 30 min DAILY, so treat this as maintaining the tissue that failed on 7 Sep, not as a 5.9% gain.

BIKE QUALITY 60 min on the D100 after iftar - 3 x 10 min at sweet spot (88-93% FTP, about 144-153 W at FTP 164), 5 min easy spin between. Ramadan: shorter session, same intensity. You can drink, so two bottles.

BRICK after iftar: 30 km on the D100 + 4 km run. Ramadan cut from 40 + 5. Run the first 10 min 20-30 s/km slower than standalone. Fuel the ride, 40-60 g carb per hour.

Long ride 2 h on the D100 after iftar, zone 2, HR under 145. Replaces the 70 km outdoor ride: nothing long while fasted, and 20:00 in February is dark and cold. Fuel 60 g carb per hour from bottles - in Ramadan the night rides are where gut training happens.

weeks.note: Buy the wetsuit now. Buy for BUOYANCY not speed - beginner suits run 5 mm through core/hips/legs, which directly fixes the sinking-legs problem. Wetsuits give the biggest gain to inefficient low-buoyancy swimmers, i.e. you: 5-11%, roughly 2-4 min over 1.9 km. Also buy neoprene BOOTIES - legal below 18.3 C and the water will be 15-17 C. ABU DHABI PREP: book Etihad if it is not done (a boxed bike travels in the checked-bag allowance - check the weight), get a bike box, and buy a spare Cube derailleur hanger to pack with it.

5 x 1 km at 10K effort after iftar, 2 min jog. Ramadan: one rep fewer than planned, same pace.

Easy ride 75 min on the D100 after iftar, zone 2. Then box the bike for Monday's flight: pedals and bars off, rear derailleur protected, spare hanger in the box.

weeks.note: ABU DHABI from Mon 22 Feb - the flight day is a rest day. Iftar there is about 18:20, so night sessions start about 19:30. Al Wathba cycle track is floodlit and open all night; the sea is 21-23 C. Sea swims only on a lifeguarded beach, with a tow buoy, never alone. GUT TRAINING STARTS - 8-12 weeks out is the window. Target 60-70 g carb/h on the bike, NOT 90: measured exogenous glucose oxidation is 33 g/h under 70 kg vs 45 g/h above it. At 56 kg your ceiling is genuinely lower. Fuel every session over 75 min, +10-15 g/h every 1-2 weeks, and use the exact race products (Maurten, Precision PH 1000). In Ramadan the night rides carry it: drink with iftar, start 60-90 min later, fuel from the first 20 min.

sessions.label: Pool swim 30 min before iftar - easy, loosen up after the flight.
4 x 1 km at 10K effort after iftar, 2 min jog. Evenings are about 20-22 C, so no heat penalty. Ramadan and the day after a flight: one rep fewer, same pace.
Pool swim 35 min before iftar - wetsuit + sighting every 6 strokes if the pool allows it, otherwise drills.

Easy run 3 km OFF THE BIKE - mini-brick, straight off Thursday's bike. Ramadan cut from 5 km. Run the first 10 min 20-30 s/km slower than feels right.

FIRST SEA SWIM, 30 min before iftar in daylight - 21-23 C, no wetsuit needed. Lifeguarded beach, tow buoy, never alone, swim parallel to the shore. Look up every 10 strokes - the sea moves you and there is no line on the bottom.
BRICK after iftar at Al Wathba: 40 km ride + 5 km run, practise 9 min run / 1 min walk. Fuel 60 g carb per hour on the bike with the race products.
Long ride 60 km at Al Wathba after iftar, steady, fuelling 60-70 g carb per hour. Fasting and travel week, so it stays at 60 km.

weeks.note: TRANSITION PRACTICE this week. Measured Venice T1 median is 7:02 and T2 5:21; p90 is 11:05 and 7:08. A fumbled pair of transitions costs 8-12 minutes - more than most people gain from an entire block of bike work. Practise wetsuit removal until it is boring. Still Ramadan in Abu Dhabi: long and hard after iftar, the sea in daylight before it.

sessions.label: Pool swim 45 min before iftar - 1800 m continuous, easy. 45 min is the fasted cap.
3 x 1.5 km at threshold after iftar, 2 min jog. Ramadan: one rep fewer, same pace.

Long run 15 km easy after iftar, HR under 158. Ramadan cut from 17 km. Carry water.
Easy ride 2 h at Al Wathba after iftar, zone 2.

weeks.note: TRANSITION WEEK. Ramadan ends about Tue 9 Mar and Eid is about Wed 10 - Eid is a rest day. Normal fed training from Thursday, mornings before the heat. Volume drops, frequency does not - never let a swim gap exceed 5 days, adult-onset swimmers lose motor patterns fast. Check the medical certificate appointment is booked for after you are home.

sessions.label: Pool swim 30 min before iftar - 1200 m easy.
4 x 1 km at 10K effort after iftar, 2 min jog. Probably the last night of Ramadan.
Swim 35 min in the morning, pool or sea - fed again, so add 4 x 50 m strong with full rest.

BIKE QUALITY 60-75 min - 3 x 12 min at sweet spot (88-93% FTP, about 144-153 W at FTP 164), 5 min easy spin between. Warm up 15 min. The 90 km bike is over half of a 70.3 by time and this is the session that builds it.

Long run 12 km easy, HR under 158. Early, before the heat.
Long ride 75 km at Al Wathba, steady - first fed long ride after Ramadan, fuelling rehearsal at 60-70 g carb per hour. Start at first light: March middays get close to 30 C.

weeks.note: Last Abu Dhabi week and the first fully fed one - the big week. You fly home Sat 20 Mar, so the brick moves to Thursday. TARGET: 1900 m continuous. The cutoff needs only 3:41/100 m and ANY STROKE IS LEGAL - breaststroke the whole thing is permitted, and you may hold a buoy or kayak to rest provided you make no forward progress. Knowing that is what stops the panic that actually causes swim DNFs.

sessions.label: Sea swim 55 min - ATTEMPT 1900 m CONTINUOUS. Lifeguarded beach, parallel to the shore, tow buoy, a buddy with you. Any stroke counts.

BRICK: 60 km ride + 10 km run at race effort, full race nutrition. Moved from Saturday because you fly home Saturday. Start at first light.
Swim 35 min easy, pool or sea.
Easy run 5 km, HR under 158. Then box the bike for the flight.

Long ride 80 km steady at IF 0.68-0.72 (112-118 W), the day after the flight home. Amsterdam is about 15 C colder than Abu Dhabi, so dress for it; if the flight wrecked your sleep, ride it Monday instead.

weeks.note: First week home: Amsterdam is about 15 C colder, so dress for the 100 km, and if Saturday's flight wrecked your sleep, ride it Monday. Biggest week. Bike pacing: target IF 0.68-0.72, cap the first 30 min 5 W BELOW target. Above 0.80 on a flat course is almost always a bike PB and a run blow-up. Also: this is a NON-DRAFTING race - 6 bike lengths clear, pass within 25 s, 5-minute penalty box. You ride in groups; this is a skill you do not have.

You should already have done 5-6 cold immersions over the winter; this is where it gets applied in a wetsuit.

weeks.note: Full dress rehearsal. Run plan is RUN/WALK from km 0, not as a fallback: 9 min run / 1 min walk blends to ~7:24/km and beats an even-paced blow-up by minutes per km. The course gives you 3 loops x 7.03 km with 9 aid stations - walk every one, 5-15 s, 3-5 good gulps.

Swim 07:00 Sloterparkbad - 50 m pool, lanes 07:00-08:00, before work. 35 min easy
DRESS REHEARSAL BRICK: 60 km at race power (72-78% FTP, about 118-128 W) + 10 km run at race effort, 9:1 run/walk, full race nutrition, race-morning breakfast and timing.
Easy ride 90 min with 3 x 5 min at race power (72-78% FTP, about 118-128 W).

weeks.note: Taper: volume down 30-50%, intensity retained, swim FREQUENCY untouched. Carb load the day before is 8-12 g/kg = 450-670 g - that is a lot of food for 56 kg and it must be rehearsed, not improvised.

sessions.label: OPEN WATER 30 min - final cold exposure. Dutch water is about 10-13 C in April: only with an organised group or a buddy who is watching, wetsuit + booties + 2 caps, 10-20 min at first. No group available? Do it as a wetsuit swim in the pool.
THRESHOLD 4 x 800 m - threshold effort (HR 175-181, comfortably hard, about your 1-hour race effort), 2 min jog between. Taper keeps the intensity and cuts the volume.
Swim 07:00 Sloterparkbad - 50 m pool, lanes 07:00-08:00, before work. 35 min - 1200 m easy
BIKE 60 min on Zwift with 3 x 8 min at race power (72-78% FTP, about 118-128 W), 4 min easy between. Taper: shorter, same intensity.
Run 3 km OFF THE BIKE, easy.
Swim 07:00 Sloterparkbad - 50 m pool, lanes 07:00-08:00, before work. 30 min
BRICK: 30 km ride + 5 km run at race pace
Easy spin 60 min, zone 2 (56-75% FTP, about 92-123 W, HR under 145), 85-95 rpm, with 3 x 2 min at race power.

weeks.note: RACE WEEK. Swim 1,898 m single counterclockwise loop from Lighthouse Beach, 4 turn buoys plus directional buoys every 100 m - unusually easy to sight. SELF-SEEDED ROLLING START, 3 athletes every 6 s: seed HONESTLY at 55-60 min, you will start ~08:15-08:30. Enter at the EDGE of your box. Water 15-17 C. Warm up in the water 06:30-07:00 then stay warm for 90 min. Swim the first 200 m deliberately too slowly. CUT-OFFS: swim 1:10 (absolute - zero finishers in 19,137 splits swam over 70:00), bike 5:30, overall 8:30. TRANSITION IS ~1 KM FROM THE SWIM START - two venues, walk it Friday. Target 6:15-7:15. Venice is a fast race: M25-29 median is 5:12, so you will be near the back of a quick field. That is fine.
